en: Now, out of compassion for sentient beings, I shall proclaim the Vidyādhara-kalpa.
Homage to the Buddha; homage to the Dharma; homage to the Saṅgha.
Homage to the Blessed One, Śākyamuni, the Greatly Compassionate One, the Tathāgata, the Arhat, the Perfectly Awakened One.
Homage to all the Perfectly Awakened Ones!
Oṃ giri giri giriṇi giriṇi girivati guṇavati ākāśavati ākāśaviśuddhe sarvapāpavigate ākāśe gaganatale ākāśavicāriṇi maṇidhari vajriṇi jvalitaśikhare maṇimuktākhacitamaulidhare!

Homage to those with beautiful hair, beautiful form, beautiful faces, and beautiful eyes; to those golden-hued; to those who have passed away, those not yet born, and those present in the present; homage to all Buddhas of blazing splendor! O Buddha, O Subuddhe, O Blessed One, O Excellent Protector, O Inexhaustible One, O Well-Extinguished One, O Subtle One, O Radiant One, O Easily Tamed One, O Well-Subdued One, O One of Good Vows, O Giver of Boons, O Most Excellent One, O Blessed One, O Auspicious One, O One of Excellent Auspiciousness!

Bhadre, Subhadre, Vimale, Jayabhadre, Caṇḍi, Pracaṇḍi, Caṇḍe, Vajracaṇḍe, Mahācaṇḍe, Gauri, Gandhāri, Caṇḍāli, Mātaṅgi, Vaccasi, Sumati, Pukkasi, Sumukhi, Śabari, Śāvari, Śaṃkari, Dramaṇḍi, Drāmaṇḍi, Raudriṇi, Sarvārthasādhani, Paramārthasādhani! Strike, strike all enemies; burn, burn them!

Cook the hearts of all the wicked—of *preta*s, *piśāca*s, *ḍākinī*s, humans, and non-humans; shatter them! Destroy the life-force of all wicked *graha*s; cause them to perish! O Blessed One, destroy all my sins! Protect, protect me and all sentient beings everywhere and at all times from all fears and calamities!
Bind, bind all the wicked! O destroyer of all sins, O Mārtaṇḍī, O wielder of the rod of death, O warder-off of the rod of death, O blissful one, O proud one, O greatly proud one, O bearer of honor,
O moving one, O immovable one, O stainless one, O Viṭi, Viṭi, Taṭi, Tiṭi, Niṭi, Niṭi, Tuṭṭe, Dhoriṇi, Dhariṇi!

Nimiṇi, viriṇi, vīryaṇi, pracale, in the preeminent battle, Caṇḍāli, Mātaṅgi, thou who obstructest, thou who seizes, thou who pierces, thou who art radiant, Sumati, Pukkasi, Śabari, Śabari, Śaṃkari, Maṇi, Draviḍi, Ḍāviḍi, thou who slayest,
thou who burnest, thou who cookest, thou who ripenest, thou who crushes, Sarali, Sarale, Saralambhe, thou who rends the low, the middling, and the excellent, Mahiri, Mahiri, Mahāmahili!
Nigaḍe, nigaḍabhañje, marte, marti, matti, mattini, dānte, cakre, cakravākini, jvale, jvale, jvalini, śabari, śābari, sarvavyādhihariṇi, muni, muni, cuṇḍi, cuṇḍi, cuṇḍini, cuṇḍini, mahācuṇḍini,
nimi, nimi, nimiṃdhari, trailokyavardhani, trilokajanani, trilokālokakari, traidhātukavyavalokani!

O you who hold the vajra, the axe, the noose, the mallet, the sword, the wheel, the trident, the wish-fulfilling gem, and the crown of great vidyās! Protect, protect me and all sentient beings from all fears of the wicked wherever they may be, from all fears of humans and non-humans, and from all diseases!
Vajre vajre vajravati vajradhare vajrapāṇidhare hiri hiri mili mili kili kili cili cili śili śili cala cala vala vala varade!
O you who grant boons with the goad, victorious everywhere, svāhā!
O destroyer of all evils, svāhā!
O remover of all diseases, svāhā!
Svāhā! O you who provide nourishment for the womb, svāhā! O you who remove fear everywhere, svāhā! May there be well-being for me and for all sentient beings, svāhā!
Oṃ bhuvaḥ svāhā! Svasti svāhā! Śānti svāhā!
Puṣṭi svāhā! Balavardhani svāhā!
Oṃ jayatu jayavati jayakamale vimale svāhā!
Vipule svāhā!
Sarvatathāgatamūrte svāhā!
Oṃ bhūri mahāśānte svāhā!
Oṃ bhuḥ bhūri bhūri vajravati, fulfiller of the hearts of all Tathāgatas, sustainer of life-force, O powerful one, O mighty one!
Oṃ jaya vijaya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ!
Oṃ maṇidhari vajriṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā!
Oṃ maṇivajre hṛdayavajre, O you who put to flight the armies of Māra, slay, slay all enemies! O Vajragarbha, terrify, terrify all the abodes of the Māras! Hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ! Saṃbhara saṃbhara svāhā!
Buddha-love, empowered by the vajra-aeon of all Tathāgatas, remove all karmic obscurations! Svāhā!
The Noble Pratisarā Kalpa Dhāraṇī is completed.
